citations.assessment: The checked Bavli gives Zutra in both attributions and ash/smoke, not herbs, in the second teaching. Preserve Heilprin’s distinct herbs and Zutri as readings of his witness.
Heilprin’s Rav Tavut entry documents a different-name tradition and a proposed emendation. It leaves the two-person question open.
